text:
sam_partnerships: Heads up team 104e6 We need final marketing assets for the AWS Marketplace listing + Intel Habana co-brand and a 1-paragraph SI solution brief for Cognizant. Deadline: tomorrow AM for marketplace submission. Drive: https://drive.redwood/partners/aws-intel-si

lina_design: Uploaded assets: `logos_v5.zip` (SVG/PNG), `tile_comps_v2.fig`, and `flat_lockups.png`. I also added a light/dark variant and PNGs sized for 1x/2x displays. Link inside drive folder to color specs.

alana_marketing: Thanks Lina. I sketched two marketplace headlines: A) "Production LLM inference on AWS with Intel Habana" (58 chars) B) "Optimize LLM throughput on AWS using Intel Habana accelerators" (68 chars) B exceeds 60 char guideline so A preferred. Need 150-char description too.

rafi_ae: For the SI brief, Cognizant wants customer-facing copy that mentions joint implementation services and a one-line outcomes metric if available. We don't yet have a cleared stat. Can we include a placeholder like "up to X%"? Legal usually dislikes placeholders.

jess_legal: No placeholders in public collateral. If you can't get a numbers approval, keep it qualitative: "reduces latency and improves inference throughput." Also Intel trademark rules: do not alter their mark, include attribution: "Intel and the Intel logo are trademarks of Intel Corporation in the U.S. and other countries." For AWS: use Amazon's badge per marketplace guide; avoid wording that implies endorsement by AWS.

sam_partnerships: FYI @priya_aws asked for the marketplace alt text and tile sizes. AWS marketplace rules attached in the drive: headline <=60 chars, description <=150 chars, image width exactly 1024px for hero, PNG or JPG, max 2MB. Also need an alt text string <=120 chars.

lina_design: Noted. I exported `marketplace_tile_1024.png` (RGB, 72dpi) and `marketplace_tile_1024@2x.png`. Alt text suggestions: "Redwood Inference on AWS with Intel Habana accelerators" (67 chars). Need it under 120, so ok.

alana_marketing: Draft description (150 chars): "Run Redwood Inference on AWS with Intel Habana accelerators for scalable, low-latency LLM serving. Preconfigured images and SI deployment support." (149 chars)

rafi_ae: SI brief blurb draft (max 3 sentences): "Redwood and Cognizant deliver turnkey LLM inference solutions on AWS accelerated by Intel Habana. The partnership combines Redwood's optimized runtime with Cognizant's systems integration to accelerate time-to-production. Professional services include deployment, tuning, and transfer-of-knowledge."

jess_legal: Approve the brief content subject to brand attributions added. Please append the Intel and AWS attribution lines in the footer of the PDF. Also add a short co-marketing clause: "Each party may use the other's trademarks solely in connection with promoting the joint solution, subject to prior approval and brand guidelines."

lina_design: Added footer text file `brand_footers.txt` with the exact attribution lines and safe-zone notes. Also attached `si_brief_layout.pdf` with Cognizant logo placement mocked up (left) and Redwood + Intel lockup (right). Cognizant legal still needs to approve placement.

alana_marketing: Quick copy tweak: change "Preconfigured images" to "Prebuilt AMIs and deployment scripts" to be explicit for AWS buyers. New description (150 chars): "Run Redwood Inference on AWS with Intel Habana accelerators for scalable, low-latency LLM serving. Prebuilt AMIs and deployment scripts included." (149 chars)

sam_partnerships: Good. Action items before publish: Lina: final tile PNG + alt text (1024px), add footer attributions to the brief; Alana: finalize marketplace description and SI blurb; Rafi: secure Cognizant logo sign-off; Jess: final legal approval of footer + co-marketing clause; I'll ping @priya_aws for final marketplace checklist once we have assets.

deploy-bot: asset-check: tile file size 1.2MB, resolution ok, alt text present, description length ok. No errors.

jess_legal: I reviewed the final text in the drive. Legal sign-off: approved for publication with the footer and co-marketing clause included.

alana_marketing: I've updated the marketplace listing copy and uploaded a final `marketplace_payload.json` for the portal team. Also dropped the SI brief PDF `cognizant-si-brief-final.pdf` in the folder.

lina_design: Uploaded final `marketplace_tile_1024_final.png` and `lockup_flattened.png`. Also included `accessibility_alt.txt` with alt text variations.

sam_partnerships: OK everyone please react with "approved" when you've reviewed final files so I can submit to AWS tomorrow AM.

alana_marketing: approved

jess_legal: approved

rafi_ae: approved pending Cognizant sign-off (I have a call at 11am PT)

sam_partnerships: Thanks team 389 I'll follow up post-call and schedule the marketplace push. Closing thread for now.
